card.name: Units or symbols after a zero
card.fires_on: The unit or symbol right after a leading 0, such as mg, mL or %, and sometimes the digit after 0 in a decimal. It appears in dose lists, tables of percentages and quantities.

modes.label: Unit after 0
modes.description: A measure like mg, mL or % directly after the number 0 (often the start of a figure such as 0.5 or 0%).

modes.label: Percent of zero in tables
modes.description: The percent sign after 0 in adverse-event or results tables.

modes.label: Digit after 0 in a decimal
modes.description: The digit following 0 in a table of decimal values.
